args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the latest deploy of v2.3.1 to production (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent release that was healthy in production, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback verified: all regions now running v2.3.0 with status rolled_out. Recommend monitoring to confirm recovery and investigating the v2.3.1 regression before any redeploy.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18.

2. **Identified the last healthy release**: Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent version that was healthy in production (v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 both healthy; v2.3.1 unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc was staging-only).

3. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback was verified — all regions now report v2.3.0 with status `rolled_out`.

4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback action, which paged the on-call engineer.

Note: I did not deploy any new version, so no change-manager approval was needed. The incident is open for follow-up investigation of the v2.3.1 regression before any future redeploy.
